gap.title: Search: a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit with at most 21 gates for the edge function of an 11-vertex graph with no 4-cycle, 16 edges and cover number 7
gap.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ (∀ x : Fin 11 → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin 11, (u.val, v.val) ∈ ([(0, 9), (0, 10), (1, 4), (1, 8), (2, 5), (2, 10), (3, 6), (3, 7), (4, 8), (4, 10), (5, 8), (5, 9), (6, 7), (6, 10), (7, 9), (8, 9)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) ∧ C.size ≤ 21
gap.unlocks: The 11-vertex graph with no 4-cycle: the cases with two or more junk AND gates
gap.context: SKETCH: no proof is expected here: propose a cut: by first gates up to symmetry, by a structural invariant, by cases. a search for a top-form AND/OR circuit of at most 21 gates for this 11-vertex graph's edge function, split by its number of junk AND gates. By a checked count, a 21-gate circuit needs the junk part to pay its inequality; enumerate the junk units first (shapes in routes/lgp/full-basis/eleven-vertex-RART.md section 4.1, with its sieve), filter, then complete the tops and the OR tree. Shard texts: routes/mining/cuts/L-meta-1342-1343-cuts.md. Size: about 60 minutes per shard.
